<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="exX0022024-11-01-15-05" status="finalized" ana="corpusmd:thal_gyur">
         <lb n="342.2"/> gzhan yang <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4267">gong bur can</rs> na re thal 'gyur <lb n="342.3"/> gnyis kyi spyi'i mtshan nyid gang yin zhes 'dri na | 'o na bsgrub pa'i ngag dang <lb n="342.4"/> sun 'byin pa'i ngag gnyis kyi spyi'i mtshan nyid kyang gang yin zhes phar la <lb n="342.5"/> dri'o ||
         thun mong ba gcig pa med do zhe na 
         snga <lb n="342.6"/> ma'ang med do ||
         de ltar na thal 'gyur tsam zhes bya ba'i mtshon bya thun mong <lb n="342.7"/> ba'ang med par thal lo || 
         snga ma la'ang rang rgyud tsam zhes bya ba'i mtshon bya <lb n="342.8"/> thun mong ba med par thal lo zhes zer ro ||</seg></TEI>
